'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]], [[Calls for a ceasefire during the Gaza war]]
***[[Hamas]] officials say that they have accepted a [[January 2025 Gaza war ceasefire|draft agreement for a potential ceasefire]] as well as the release of [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]]. Mediators in the [[United States]] and [[Qatar]] also state that this is the closest that both sides have been to a ceasefire agreement so far. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-01-14-2025-a1495c0f4f13102903ce31a862c49baa (AP)]
**[[Israeli incursions in the West Bank (2023–present)|Israeli incursions in the West Bank]]
***Four [[Al-Qassam Brigades]] militants and two civilians are killed during an Israeli [[airstrike]] in [[Jenin]], in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/1/15/live-israel-launches-fierce-strikes-on-gaza-as-ceasefire-deal-moves-closer?update=3442835 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Attacks in Russia during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Armed Forces of Ukraine|Ukraine]] strikes targets in the [[Republic of Tatarstan]] and [[Bryansk Oblast|Bryansk]], [[Saratov Oblast|Saratov]], and [[Tula Oblast|Tula]] oblasts, [[Russia]], with more than 200 drones and five [[ATACMS]] ballistic missiles, hitting ammunition depots, industrial plants and a [[refinery]], in what [[Ukraine]] says is its "most massive" and "deepest" attack inside Russia so far. [https://edition.cnn.com/2025/01/14/europe/ukraine-russia-drone-missile-attack-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwypg2z780go (BBC News)]
*[[List of North Korean missile tests|North Korean missile tests]]
**[[Korean People's Army|North Korea]] launches multiple [[short-range ballistic missile]]s into the [[Sea of Japan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/north-korea-fires-missile-off-east-coast-says-south-korea-military-2025-01-14/ (Reuters)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**[[Yemen]]'s [[Houthi]] forces fire a missile at [[Israel]], triggering [[civil defense siren|sirens]] in several areas, including [[Tel Aviv]] and some Israeli settlements in the occupied [[West Bank]]. According to the [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli military]], the missile was "likely intercepted" with no injuries reported. [https://english.news.cn/20250114/7d596dc7d5e6418683867e53dbecb391/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 43 vehicles figured in a pileup caused by icy conditions along the [[Seoul]]-[[Munsan]] Expressway near [[Goyang]], injuring nine. [https://en.yna.co.kr/view/AEN20250114002500315 (Yonhap News Agency)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[World Health Organization]] reports a suspected [[Marburg virus disease|Marburg virus]] outbreak in [[Kagera Region|Kagera]], [[Tanzania]], with nine cases and eight deaths. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-outbreak-marburg-virus-kills-eight-tanzania-who-says-2025-01-15/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Baltic Sea submarine cable disruptions]], [[List of NATO operations|NATO operations]]
**At the Summit of Baltic Sea Allies in [[Helsinki]], [[Finland]], [[Secretary General of NATO|NATO Secretary General]] [[Mark Rutte]] announces the establishment of the ''Baltic Sentry'' military mission, which will strengthen the protection of critical infrastructure in the region, such as [[submarine power cable|energy]] and [[submarine communications cable|communication cables]], from "destabilizing acts". [https://www.nato.int/cps/cz/natohq/news_232122.htm?selectedLocale=en (NATO News)]
*[[Armenia–United States relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Armenia)|Armenian Foreign Minister]], [[Ararat Mirzoyan]], and the [[United States Secretary of State|U.S. Secretary of State]], [[Antony Blinken]], sign in [[Washington, DC]] a Strategic Partnership Charter between [[Armenia]] and the [[United States]]. [https://thedefensepost.com/2025/01/14/armenia-signs-us-pact/ (The Defense Post)]
*[[Cuba–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that the [[United States]] will remove [[Cuba]] from its [[State Sponsors of Terrorism (U.S. list)|state sponsors of terrorism list]] as part of a prisoner release deal. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c17e0k92g41o (BBC News)]
